40022077.author: पदार्थः
40022077.content: एवम् thus, ब्रुवद्भिः by those speaking, ऋषिभिः by the sages, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, किम् what, कार्यम् task, ब्रूत tell, मुनयः O sages, भयम् fear, तावत् first of all, अपैतु let it depart, वः from you.

40022077.author: Translation
40022077.content: When the sages spoke thus, Rama replied, "O sages, tell me what the task is; first of all, let your fear depart."

40022078.author: पदार्थः
40022078.content: तथा thus, ब्रुवति when speaking, काकुत्स्थे Kakutstha (Rama), भार्गवः Bhargava (Chyavana), वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, भयानाम् of the fears, शृणु listen, यत् which, मूलम् origin, देशस्य of the region, च and, नरेश्वर O lord of men.

40022078.author: Translation
40022078.content: When Rama spoke thus, Bhargava (Chyavana) replied, "O King, listen to the origin of our fears and of this region."

40022079.author: पदार्थः
40022079.content: पूर्वम् formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, राजन् O King, दैतेयः a Daitya, सुमहाबलः exceedingly powerful, लोलापुत्रः son of Lola, अभवत् was, ज्येष्ठः the eldest, मधुः Madhu, नाम named, महासुरः a great demon.

40022079.author: Translation
40022079.content: O King, formerly in the Krita Yuga, there was an exceedingly powerful Daitya, the eldest son of Lola, named Madhu, who was a great demon.

40022080.author: पदार्थः
40022080.content: ब्रह्मण्यश्च one devoted to Brahmins and, शरण्यश्च one who offers refuge and, बुद्ध्या by intellect, च and, परिनिष्ठितः firmly established, सुरैश्च with gods and, परमोदारैः exceedingly generous, प्रीतिः affection, तस्य for him, अतुला unequalled, अभवत् was

40022080.author: Translation
40022080.content: He was devoted to Brahmins, a protector, and firmly resolved in his wisdom, and he had an unequalled affection for the exceedingly generous gods.

40022081.author: पदार्थः
40022081.content: सः he, मधुः Madhu, वीर्यसम्पन्नः endowed with valor, धर्मे in righteousness, च and, सुसमाहितः well-established, बहुवर्षसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, रुद्रप्रीत्या to please Rudra, अकरोत् performed, तपः penance

40022081.author: Translation
40022081.content: That Madhu, endowed with great valor and steadfast in righteousness, performed penance for many thousands of years to please Rudra.

40022082.author: पदार्थः
40022082.content: रुद्रः Rudra, प्रीतः pleased, अभवत् became, तस्मै for him, वरं boon, दातुम् to give, ययौ went, च and, सः he (Rudra), बहुमानात् with great respect, च and, रुद्रेण by Rudra, दत्तः given, तस्य for him, अद्भुतः wonderful, वरः boon

40022082.author: Translation
40022082.content: Rudra became pleased with him and went to grant a boon, and with great respect, an extraordinary boon was given to him by Rudra.

40022083.author: पदार्थः
40022083.content: शूलं trident, शूलात् from his own trident, विनिष्कृष्य extracting, महावीर्यं of great power, महाप्रभम् of great splendor, ददौ gave, महात्मा the great-souled one, सुप्रीतः very pleased, वाक्यं words, च and, एतत् this, उवाच spoke, ह indeed

40022083.author: Translation
40022083.content: The great-souled Rudra, very pleased, extracted a trident of great power and splendor from his own trident, gave it, and indeed spoke these words.

40022084.author: पदार्थः
40022084.content: त्वया by you, अयम् this, अतुलः unequalled, धर्मः righteousness, मत् my, प्रसादकरः pleasing, कृतः done, प्रीत्या with affection, परमया supreme, युक्तः endowed, ददामि I give, आयुधम् weapon, उत्तमम् excellent

40022084.author: Translation
40022084.content: “This unequalled act of righteousness, which pleases me, has been performed by you; filled with supreme affection, I give you this excellent weapon.”

40022085.author: पदार्थः
40022085.content: यावत् as long as, सुरैः with gods, च and, विप्रैः with Brahmins, च and, न not, विरुध्येः you contend/oppose, महासुर O great Asura, तावत् so long, शूलं the spear, तव your, इदं this, स्यात् shall be, अन्यथा otherwise, नाशम् destruction, एष्यति it will attain.

40022085.author: Translation
40022085.content: O great Asura, as long as you do not contend with gods and Brahmins, this spear shall remain yours; otherwise, it will meet its destruction.

40022086.author: पदार्थः
40022086.content: यः whoever, च and, त्वाम् you, अभियुञ्जीत challenges, युद्धाय for battle, विगतज्वरः free from fear, तम् him, शूलः the spear, भस्मसात्कृत्वा having reduced to ashes, पुनः again, एष्यति it will come, ते your, करम् hand.

40022086.author: Translation
40022086.content: Whoever fearlessly challenges you to battle, the spear will reduce him to ashes and then return to your hand.

40022087.author: पदार्थः
40022087.content: एवम् thus, रुद्रात् from Rudra, वरम् a boon, लब्ध्वा having obtained, भूयः again, एव indeed, महासुरः the great Asura, प्रणिपत्य having bowed down, महादेवं to the great god, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40022087.author: Translation
40022087.content: Having thus obtained a boon from Rudra, the great Asura bowed down to the great god and spoke these words again.

40022088.author: पदार्थः
40022088.content: भगवन् O Lord, मम my, वंशस्य of the lineage, शूलम् the spear, एतत् this, अनुत्तमम् excellent, भवेत् may it be, तु indeed, सततम् always, देव O God, सुराणाम् of the gods, ईश्वरः the lord, हि for, असि you are.

40022088.author: Translation
40022088.content: O Lord, may this excellent spear always remain with my lineage, for you are indeed the lord of the gods.

40022089.author: पदार्थः
40022089.content: तम् to him, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, मधुम् to Madhu, देवः the god, सर्वभूतपतिः lord of all beings, शिवः Shiva, प्रत्युवाच replied, महातेजा greatly effulgent, न not, एतत् this, एवम् thus, भविष्यति will be.

40022089.author: Translation
40022089.content: To Madhu, who was speaking thus, the greatly effulgent god Shiva, the lord of all beings, replied, "This will not be so."

40022090.author: पदार्थः
40022090.content: मा भूत् let it not be, ते your, विफला fruitless, वाणी word/speech, मत्प्रसादकृता made by my grace, शुभा auspicious, भवतः your, पुत्रम् son, एकम् one, तु indeed, शूलम् trident, एतत् this, भजिष्यते will possess.

40022090.author: Translation
40022090.content: May your auspicious words, granted by my grace, not be in vain; indeed, only one of your sons will possess this trident.

40022091.author: पदार्थः
40022091.content: यावत् as long as, करस्थः in hand, शूलः trident, अयम् this, भविष्यति will be, सुतस्य of the son, ते your, अवध्यः unslayable, सर्वभूतानाम् by all beings, शूलहस्तः one with a trident in hand, भविष्यति will be.

40022091.author: Translation
40022091.content: As long as this trident remains in your son's hand, he will be invincible to all beings, being one who wields the trident.

40022092.author: पदार्थः
40022092.content: एवम् thus, मधुः Madhu, वरम् boon, लब्ध्वा having obtained, देवात् from the god, सुमहत् very great, अद्भुतम् wonderful, भवनम् dwelling/city, सः he, असुरश्रेष्ठः best of demons, कारयामास caused to be built, सुप्रभम् very splendid.

40022092.author: Translation
40022092.content: Thus, having obtained this very great and wonderful boon from the god, Madhu, the best of demons, caused a splendid city to be built.

40022093.author: पदार्थः
40022093.content: तस्य his, पत्नी wife, महाभागा highly fortunate, प्रिया beloved, कुम्भीनसी Kumbhinasi, इति thus, या who, विश्वावसोः of Vishvavasu, अपत्यम् offspring/daughter, सा she, हि indeed, अनलायाम् in Anala, महाप्रभा very radiant.

40022093.author: Translation
40022093.content: His beloved and highly fortunate wife was Kumbhinasi, who was indeed the very radiant daughter of Vishvavasu by Anala.

40022094.author: पदार्थः
40022094.content: तस्याः her, पुत्रः son, महावीर्यः very powerful, लवणः Lavana, नाम named, दारुणः terrible, बाल्यात्प्रभृति from childhood onwards, दुष्टात्मा evil-minded, पापानि sins, एव only, समाचरत् committed.

40022094.author: Translation
40022094.content: Her son was the very powerful and terrible Lavana, who, being evil-minded, committed only sinful deeds from his childhood onwards.

40022095.author: पदार्थः
40022095.content: तं that, पुत्रं son, दुर्विनीतं ill-behaved, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, क्रोधसमन्वितः filled with anger, मधुः Madhu, सः he, शोकम् sorrow, आपेदे attained, न not, च and, एनं him, किञ्चित् anything, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40022095.author: Translation
40022095.content: Seeing his ill-behaved son, Madhu was filled with anger and sorrow, yet he did not say anything to him.

40022096.author: पदार्थः
40022096.content: सः he (Madhu), विहाय having abandoned, तु indeed, इमं this, लोकं world, प्रविष्टो entered, वरुणालयम् the abode of Varuna, शूलं the trident, निवेश्य having placed, लवणे to Lavana, वरं a boon, तस्मै to him, न्यवेदयत् offered.

40022096.author: Translation
40022096.content: Madhu, having left this world, entered the abode of Varuna, and after placing the trident with Lavana, he offered a boon to him.

40022097.author: पदार्थः
40022097.content: सः he (Lavana), प्रभावेण by the power, शूलस्य of the trident, दौरात्म्येनात्मनस्तथा and by his own wickedness, सन्तापयति torments, लोकांस्त्रीन् the three worlds, विशेषेण especially, च and, तापसान् ascetics.

40022097.author: Translation
40022097.content: Lavana, by the power of the trident and his own wickedness, torments the three worlds, especially the ascetics.

40022098.author: पदार्थः
40022098.content: एवंप्रभावो such is the power, लवणः of Lavana, शूलं the trident, च and, एव indeed, तथाविधम् of such a kind, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रमाणं (you are our) authority/refuge, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha (Rama), त्वं you, हि indeed, नः our, परमा ultimate, गतिः refuge.

40022098.author: Translation
40022098.content: Having heard of Lavana's power and the nature of his trident, O Rama, you are our ultimate refuge and authority.

40022099.author: पदार्थः
40022099.content: बहवः many, पार्थिवा kings, राम O Rama, भयार्तैः by those afflicted with fear, ऋषिभिः by sages, पुरा formerly, अभयं protection, याचिता were implored, वीर O hero, त्रातारं a protector, न not, च and, विद्महे we know.

40022099.author: Translation
40022099.content: O Rama, many kings were formerly implored for protection by fear-stricken sages, but we do not know of any true protector.

40022100.author: पदार्थः
40022100.content: ते those, वयम् we, रावणम् Ravana, श्रुत्वा having heard, हतम् killed, सबलवाहनम् with his army and vehicles, त्रातारम् protector, विद्महे we know, तात O dear one, न not, अन्यम् another, भुवि on earth, नराधिपम् king, तत् therefore, परित्रातुम् to protect, इच्छामः we wish, लवणात् from Lavana, भयपीडितान् those afflicted by fear.

40022100.author: Translation
40022100.content: Having heard that Ravana, along with his army and vehicles, has been killed, we know no other king on earth as a protector, and therefore, O dear one, we wish for you to protect those afflicted by fear from Lavana.

40022101.author: पदार्थः
40022101.content: इति thus, राम O Rama, निवेदितम् reported, तु indeed, ते by them, भयजम् born of fear, कारणम् cause, उत्थितम् arisen, च and, यत् which, विनिवारयितुम् to remove, भवान् you, क्षमः capable, कुरु do, तम् that, कामम् wish, अहीनविक्रम O one of undiminished valor.

40022101.author: Translation
40022101.content: O Rama of undiminished valor, you are capable of removing this cause of fear that has arisen and been reported, so please fulfill that wish. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 61 ।। Thus ends the sixty-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
